# Jane Andrews

## Overview

- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v3 c35 P39](../source/v03-c35.md#nw-v03-c35-p0039)</sub>
- **Status:** Alive
- **Origin:** Avonlea  <sub>[v3 c35 P44](../source/v03-c35.md#nw-v03-c35-p0044)</sub>
- **Role:** Teacher  <sub>[v1 c30 P21](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0021)</sub>

## Appearance

Jane is described as a plain little plodder with a fat paw. Her appearance lacks the dramatic color of some of her peers, though she wears fine garments like a white satin nightdress trimmed with seed pearls in her fictional writings.

_Sources: [v3 c35 P39](../source/v03-c35.md#nw-v03-c35-p0039), [v3 c39 P21](../source/v03-c39.md#nw-v03-c39-p0021)_

## Personality

Jane is a matter-of-fact, practical girl who lacks the courage and dramatic flair of Anne Shirley. She is a dedicated student and skilled cook, described as a plain plodder who stays composed and sensible in real life despite writing tragic, tearful stories. Though cautious and easily frightened, she holds strong views on practical matters like marriage and independence.

_Sources: [v1 c28 P2](../source/v01-c28.md#nw-v01-c28-p0002), [v1 c30 P21](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0021), [v3 c35 P43](../source/v03-c35.md#nw-v03-c35-p0043), [v3 c39 P21](../source/v03-c39.md#nw-v03-c39-p0021), [v3 c39 P27](../source/v03-c39.md#nw-v03-c39-p0027)_

## History

Jane grew up in Avonlea as a classmate and friend of Anne Shirley, Diana Barry, and Ruby Gillis. In her youth, she participated in childhood games such as the Story Club and a dramatization of Tennyson's Elaine on the pond, though her practical nature made her hesitant to act in dramatic roles. She joined the Queen's class at Avonlea School to study for her teacher's license, declaring an intention to devote her life to teaching so she could earn her own independent income. While attending school, she wrote romantic and tragic fictional stories featuring heroines in luxurious gowns. In later years, Jane became engaged to Mr. Inglis, a wealthy Englishman with mines, who showered her with expensive jewelry including a large diamond cluster ring. In May, she got married in a blaze of splendor and moved away to travel in Europe before settling into a large mansion in Winnipeg.

_Sources: [v1 c28 P2](../source/v01-c28.md#nw-v01-c28-p0002), [v1 c28 P7](../source/v01-c28.md#nw-v01-c28-p0007), [v1 c28 P11](../source/v01-c28.md#nw-v01-c28-p0011), [v1 c30 P20](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0020), [v1 c30 P21](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0021), [v3 c35 P39](../source/v03-c35.md#nw-v03-c35-p0039), [v3 c35 P44](../source/v03-c35.md#nw-v03-c35-p0044), [v3 c39 P27](../source/v03-c39.md#nw-v03-c39-p0027), [v3 c39 P35](../source/v03-c39.md#nw-v03-c39-p0035)_
